$comment: Shared geo-reference. Web game, Godot project and the Python pipeline ALL use this. Never hardcode these numbers anywhere else.

origin.name: The Ridge, Shimla
origin.note: World-space (0, y, 0) sits here. Ye Shimla ka dil hai - Christ Church, Scandal Point, Mall Road sab yahin.

$comment_mpd: WGS-84 values evaluated at latitude 31.1048 N. Local tangent-plane approximation - 8 km ke andar error < 1 m.

axes.y: up, metres (absolute elevation above sea level)
axes.z: south, metres  (north = negative z, matches Three.js and Godot forward = -Z)

world.$comment_bounds: 8.192 km x 8.192 km. Isme poora Shimla sheher aa jata hai: Summer Hill se Sanjauli/Dhalli tak, Annandale se New Shimla tak, aur Jakhoo (2455 m) beech mein. Mashobra, Kufri, Naldehra aur Tara Devi is box ke bahar hain - wo 'shimla_extended' preset mein hain (docs/ROADMAP.md dekho).

conversion.lat_lon_to_world: x = (lon - origin.lon) * meters_per_degree_lon;  z = -(lat - origin.lat) * meters_per_degree_lat
conversion.world_to_lat_lon: lon = origin.lon + x / meters_per_degree_lon;  lat = origin.lat - z / meters_per_degree_lat
